== Description ==

The stream room at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 5 October 2025, showing [[Benji Chu]] (back, black cap) playing [[Brian Fred]] (seated, dark T-shirt) at the stream table with [[Jonny Chu]] (standing right, black zip jacket over green Team Albany shirt); left standing player and background unlabeled.
